summary.text: Liz Lee is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 67A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She lives in St. Paul and faces Republican Jennifer McPherson in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Liz Lee lives in St. Paul, Minnesota, and earned a B.A. in political science from Yale University.
Lee defeated incumbent John Thompson in the August 2022 Democratic primary for District 67A and Scott Hesselgrave in the November 2022 general election, taking office on January 3, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Education Finance, Elections Finance and Policy (Co-Vice Chair), and House Taxes committees.
